text: つぎの　へやに　すすむと　いいわ！

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: と　いい after a verb means 'it would be good to do that', a way of suggesting or allowing. すすむと　いい = 'you should go on'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to round off a statement. いいわ = 'it's fine'.
